title: Hotel info
loadError: We couldn't load the hotel info.
readOnlyHint: Your subscription is read-only — reactivate to edit.

names.moreLanguagesHint: Guests using these languages see English until you translate.
names.help: Arabic and English are required; other languages fall back to English.

essentials.title: Essentials
essentials.intro: Pinned first for guests — WiFi, key numbers and checkout time.
essentials.wifiPasswordHelp: Guests get a tap-to-copy button for this.
essentials.phoneHelp: Shown as tap-to-call. Include the country code, e.g. +20 100 123 4567.
essentials.checkoutHelp: Pulled from Stays → Settings; change it there.
essentials.empty: Nothing filled yet — guests won't see this card until you save something.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.emptyHint: Pool, gym, spa, kids club — each with opening hours so guests see “Open now”.

services.title: Services
services.emptyHint: Laundry, babysitting, late checkout — say how guests get each one.

house_rules.title: House rules & good to know
house_rules.emptyHint: Quiet hours, pool towels, smoking policy — short and clear.

entryModal.windowsHint: Hotel-local times. Overnight windows like 20:00–02:00 work. Leave empty for always open.
entryModal.locationNoteHelp: Where to find it — e.g. Building B, floor 2.
entryModal.howToHelp: e.g. Call reception, or leave the bag at your door before 9:00.
entryModal.priceNoteHelp: Free text — e.g. From 50 EGP per kg.
entryModal.photoInvalid: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB.

about.title: About the hotel
about.intro: A short story of the place — paragraphs only, plus up to {max} photos.
about.textHelp: Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
about.saveFirst: Save the about text first, then add photos.
about.empty: Not written yet — guests won't see this card.

noPermission.title: No access to hotel info
noPermission.hint: You need the “Manage hotel info” permission. Ask a manager to grant it.
